statute_note: Principal source selected: LankaLaw consolidated HTML (statutes/HTML/14-1964-local-authorities-housing-act.html), chain to Act No. 63 of 1979; byte-identical to the canonical parse SRC073-14-1964.json before this pass's hand corrections. Other sources inspected: Legislative Enactments 1980 Vol. III Cap. 601 (registry PDF, text layer, PDF pp. 254-257), verification source, carried in the package; Government Printer scan of the Act as enacted (statutes/incoming/local-authorities-housing-ordinance-14-1964.pdf, 7 pp, no text layer; title page and pp. 2-3 read), carried; LankaLaw HTML of Act 63 of 1979 (complete; parsed) and its Government Printer scan (5 pp, read in full), both carried. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 63 of 1979 (both editions). Review performed: one worker; section list (1-12 with 5A and 11A, 14 sections) and chain header compared with the Cap. 601 print; all 14 headings compared with the Cap. 601 marginal notes (three corrected); word-level coverage against the Cap. 601 text (2867 words, 508 unmatched = 17.72%, almost entirely single letters from the letter-spaced text layer plus running headers and front matter; the unmatched list was read); s.3(3)(b), 5A and 11A read against the Act 63 of 1979 scan. No Step 7 subagent rounds. Amendment coverage: 1 reconciliation row; 63 of 1979 already in the baseline, its three operations corroborated by the amending tree; the corrupted marker on 3(3)(b) resolved by hand. Nothing applied. OCR or structural weaknesses: the compendium text layer is heavily letter-spaced, which is why the coverage figure is high; the amending tree's 5A was re-structured by hand from a flat parse and its layout choices are noted on the nodes. Missing sources: none for the chain. Unresolved questions: statute_commencement.csv gives 1964-04-01 and needs correcting to 1975-04-01; the LankaLaw marker regex does not read '[section 2, ...]' or '[§ n, ...]' forms. Lawyer verification: unverified.
